---
title: "White Papers & Technical Reports"
description: "Technical reports, preprints, and working papers"
---

<div class="papers-container">

<div class="papers-header">
<div class="header-badge">📄 White Papers</div>
<h1>White Papers & Technical Reports</h1>
<p class="header-subtitle">Technical reports, preprints, and working papers</p>
</div>

<div class="papers-filters">
<div class="search-box">
<input type="text" placeholder="Search white papers..." id="whitepaper-search">
</div>
<div class="filter-group">
<select id="wp-year-filter">
<option value="">All Years</option>
<option value="2026">2026</option>
<option value="2025">2025</option>
<option value="2024">2024</option>
</select>
<select id="wp-type-filter">
<option value="">All Types</option>
<option value="preprint">Preprint</option>
<option value="technical-report">Technical Report</option>
<option value="working-paper">Working Paper</option>
</select>
</div>
</div>

<div class="papers-grid" id="whitepaper-list">
<div class="paper-card empty-state">
<div class="empty-icon">📭</div>
<h3>No white papers yet</h3>
<p>Technical reports and preprints will appear here.</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="papers-stats">
<div class="stat-item">
<span class="stat-number" id="wp-count">0</span>
<span class="stat-label">White Papers</span>
</div>
<div class="stat-item">
<span class="stat-number" id="wp-preprints">0</span>
<span class="stat-label">Preprints</span>
</div>
<div class="stat-item">
<span class="stat-number" id="wp-reports">0</span>
<span class="stat-label">Technical Reports</span>
</div>
</div>

</div>

<script>
const whitePapers = [];

function renderWhitePapers() {
  const container = document.getElementById('whitepaper-list');
  if (whitePapers.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = `
      <div class="paper-card empty-state">
        <div class="empty-icon">📭</div>
        <h3>No white papers yet</h3>
        <p>Technical reports and preprints will appear here.</p>
        <p class="empty-hint">This section will contain working papers, preprints, and technical reports.</p>
      </div>
    `;
    return;
  }
  
  container.innerHTML = whitePapers.map(paper => `
    <div class="paper-card whitepaper-card" data-type="${paper.type}">
      <div class="paper-badge whitepaper-badge">${paper.type}</div>
      <h3 class="paper-title">${paper.title}</h3>
      <p class="paper-authors">${paper.authors}</p>
      <div class="paper-meta">
        <span class="paper-type">${paper.type}</span>
        <span class="paper-year">${paper.year}</span>
      </div>
      <p class="paper-abstract">${paper.abstract}</p>
      <div class="paper-tags">
        ${paper.tags.map(tag => `<span class="tag">${tag}</span>`).join('')}
      </div>
      <div class="paper-actions">
        ${paper.pdf ? `<a href="${paper.pdf}" class="btn primary">📄 PDF</a>` : ''}
        ${paper.code ? `<a href="${paper.code}" class="btn secondary">💻 Code</a>` : ''}
      </div>
    </div>
  `).join('');
  
  document.getElementById('wp-count').textContent = whitePapers.length;
}

document.getElementById('whitepaper-search').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
  const query = e.target.value.toLowerCase();
  const filtered = whitePapers.filter(p => 
    p.title.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
    p.authors.toLowerCase().includes(query)
  );
  renderFilteredWhitePapers(filtered);
});

function renderFilteredWhitePapers(papers) {
  const container = document.getElementById('whitepaper-list');
  if (papers.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = `
      <div class="paper-card empty-state">
        <div class="empty-icon">🔍</div>
        <h3>No papers found</h3>
        <p>Try adjusting your search or filters.</p>
      </div>
    `;
    return;
  }
  
  container.innerHTML = papers.map(paper => `
    <div class="paper-card whitepaper-card" data-type="${paper.type}">
      <div class="paper-badge whitepaper-badge">${paper.type}</div>
      <h3 class="paper-title">${paper.title}</h3>
      <p class="paper-authors">${paper.authors}</p>
      <div class="paper-meta">
        <span class="paper-type">${paper.type}</span>
        <span class="paper-year">${paper.year}</span>
      </div>
      <p class="paper-abstract">${paper.abstract}</p>
      <div class="paper-actions">
        ${paper.pdf ? `<a href="${paper.pdf}" class="btn primary">📄 PDF</a>` : ''}
      </div>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

renderWhitePapers();
</script>

<style>
/* Reuse papers-container styles from journal page */
.papers-container {
  max-width: 1400px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 2rem;
}

.papers-header {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
}

.header-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f59e0b 0%, #d97706 100%);
  color: white;
  padding: 0.5rem 1.5rem;
  border-radius: 50px;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.papers-header h1 {
  font-size: 2.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  color: #1a202c;
}

.header-subtitle {
  color: #718096;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.papers-filters {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.search-box {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 300px;
}

.search-box input {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  border: 2px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 1rem;
  transition: border-color 0.2s;
}

.search-box input:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: #f59e0b;
}

.filter-group {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.filter-group select {
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  border: 2px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 1rem;
  background: white;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.papers-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(400px, 1fr));
  gap: 1.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
}

.paper-card {
  background: white;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 1.5rem;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
  position: relative;
}

.paper-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
}

.paper-badge {
  position: absolute;
  top: 1rem;
  right: 1rem;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
  border-radius: 20px;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.whitepaper-badge {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f59e0b 0%, #d97706 100%);
  color: white;
}

.paper-title {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  color: #1a202c;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.paper-authors {
  color: #4a5568;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.paper-meta {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: #718096;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.paper-abstract {
  color: #4a5568;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.paper-tags {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.tag {
  background: #edf2f7;
  color: #4a5568;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
  border-radius: 20px;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.paper-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.btn {
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: none;
}

.btn.primary {
  background: #667eea;
  color: white;
}

.btn.primary:hover {
  background: #5a67d8;
}

.btn.secondary {
  background: #edf2f7;
  color: #4a5568;
}

.btn.secondary:hover {
  background: #e2e8f0;
}

.empty-state {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 3rem;
}

.empty-icon {
  font-size: 4rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.empty-state h3 {
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  color: #1a202c;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.empty-state p {
  color: #718096;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.empty-hint {
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  color: #a0aec0;
  font-style: italic;
}

.papers-stats {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 3rem;
  padding: 2rem;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fef3c7 0%, #fde68a 100%);
  border-radius: 12px;
}

.stat-item {
  text-align: center;
}

.stat-number {
  display: block;
  font-size: 2.5rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #f59e0b;
  margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
}

.stat-label {
  color: #718096;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .papers-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  
  .papers-filters {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  
  .search-box {
    min-width: 100%;
  }
  
  .papers-stats {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 1.5rem;
  }
}
</style>
